plaid.title: 银行及证券账户连接
plaid.description: Connect your U.S. accounts directly with Plaid. American Express credit cards and Merrill Edge self-directed accounts are supported. Daily updates begin after you review the first import.
plaid.failed: The connection could not be completed. Retry or reconnect.
plaid.anotherLogin: I am connecting another login at this institution.
plaid.limits: Creating another connection may count toward your Plaid plan’s connection limit.
plaid.disconnectConfirm: Revoke this connection? Imported financial history will be kept. A failed revocation stays pending until it succeeds.
plaid.mappingHelp: Choose an empty local account with the same currency and account type. Bank and card accounts need transaction tracking; brokerage accounts need holdings tracking.
plaid.merrillConfirm: These are Merrill Edge self-directed accounts.
plaid.reviewHelp: Review posted transactions and confirm the opening balance against your statement. Pending transactions wait until posted. Matched transfers import after both account previews are approved.
plaid.opening: Opening balance (cash is positive; debt is negative)
plaid.pairHelp: Choose the other account and its corresponding transaction. Equal amounts alone do not establish a match.
plaid.historyHelp: Holdings determine current values. Investment transactions are provider history and do not establish complete historical performance. Provider buys show cash outflows as positive and sales as negative.
plaid.opaqueConfirm: Use Plaid’s reported values for instruments in this preview without a supported market identity. They will be tracked separately with provider-supplied prices.
plaid.cutover: Import starting on (existing transaction history only)
plaid.cutoverHelp: For an existing bank or card account, choose a date after its last recorded transaction. Existing history is preserved; stop overlapping CSV imports. Leave this blank for an empty account.
plaid.removedHelp: Plaid 已删除这些记录。未经编辑的记录将在批准时删除。如果导入被阻止，请查看链接的本地交易，明确处理编辑内容或转账配对，然后重试批准。也可以保持账户暂停；本地编辑绝不会被自动丢弃。
plaid.removeConnectionConfirm: 移除此未使用的已断开连接？本地账户和已导入历史将保留。
plaid.noProviderAccounts: Plaid 未返回任何账户。请重试，或重新连接并授权您要共享的账户。
plaid.noEligibleAccounts: Plaid 返回的账户均不适用于此连接。请重新连接并检查已授权的账户。
plaid.noLocalAccounts: 没有兼容的本地账户。请新建使用相同币种、账户类型和所需跟踪模式的账户。

investments.help: 切换为交易跟踪前，请审核交易和现金变动，并填写已核实的期初单位成本。期初持仓使用汇总成本，而非原始税务批次。

investments.confirmUpdate: 我已审核这些变更，并同意更新账本。
